name: Fighter
description: Builds Momentum through direct damage and converts it into empowered strikes.

focuses.name: Juggernaut Trance
focuses.description: Overpower also grants 12% damage reduction and 20% crowd control resistance for 8 seconds.

focuses.name: Duelists Claim
focuses.description: Overpower marks the primary target for 10 seconds. Your Essence effects against the marked target gain +10% Effect Potency. The marked enemy deals 8% less damage to you. If the mark is an ally, your healing/barriers/buffs on that ally gain +10% Effect Potency and the ally takes 8% less damage.

focuses.name: Finishers Surge
focuses.description: If an Overpowered Essence ability defeats an enemy or saves an ally below 30% Health with healing/barrier, refund 30 Battle Rhythm and reduce Overpower's remaining cooldown by 25%.

coreMechanic: Gain Momentum from direct damage. At 100 Momentum, empower the next direct damage active effect.

skillTreeNodes.name: Bruisers Grit
skillTreeNodes.description: Max Health +5%. Taking direct Health damage grants +4 additional Battle Rhythm. After you hit with a direct Essence ability, heal for 1% Max Health. 3 second internal cooldown.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Colossus Grip
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: EquipmentOverride. You may equip a Two-Handed weapon in your Offhand slot. Offhand Two-Handed weapons contribute 55% base weapon damage, 40% offensive attributes, and 25% defensive/utility attributes. Direct Melee Essence abilities gain Offhand Impact, adding a second weapon coefficient hit at 35% value. Penalty: Action Speed -10%, Dodge and Parry -30%, self-applied Barrier effects -10%, and shield/offhand-specific effects are disabled.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching EquipmentOverride.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Martial Imprint
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DeliveryConversion. After a basic attack or direct Melee Essence ability, your next non-Melee direct hostile Essence ability within 4 seconds gains the Melee and Weapon tags and can trigger weapon effects at 40% value. The ability keeps its original damage type and scaling. If the ability was already Melee, it gains +6% Effect Potency instead. Does not apply to Summon, Trap, Aura, or pure persistent tick effects.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching DeliveryConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Bloodied Tempo
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: DefensiveConversion. After you take Health damage, your next healing, barrier, or self-buff Essence ability within 6 seconds becomes Bloodied: +8% Effect Potency and +10 Battle Rhythm. After using a Bloodied ability, your next direct hostile Essence ability within 5 seconds heals you for 2% Max Health. 8 second internal cooldown.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching DefensiveConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
